title: Confidence-colored protein structure
alt: Ribbon-like predicted protein structure colored by confidence, with regions shown in blue, cyan, yellow, and orange.
caption: A confidence-colored predicted protein structure; an AI-produced scientific representation is not simply the answer.
teachingUse: Makes visible the distinction between a useful prediction, uncertainty within the representation, and scientific understanding.
